LINEAGE_BINDING_FAILURE: required lineage record missing at minting
lineage record fails verification after minting

lineage record set changed between minting/checkpoint/reprojection

cause_code_site_mapping.note: REOPEN-mechanism failures (forged REOPEN accepted, REOPEN control precondition unmet, valid REOPEN did not question gen1) map to REOPEN_NOT_OBSERVED. Receipt-integrity failures (binding validation, phase-PID map mismatch) map to RECEIPT_MUTATION. Scientific FAIL remains ONLY FAIL_RSI_005_REQUIRED_ANCESTRY_NOT_ENFORCED for an otherwise valid experiment where lineage semantics fail.

verdict_precedence.diagnostics: Diagnostics remain cause_codes only. Exactly one formal verdict plus one cause_code is emitted.
verdict_precedence.explicit_cause_code_propagation: PreconditionFailure carries an EXPLICIT cause_code passed at the raise site; classification is never inferred from message substrings (the old _cause_for_precondition heuristic is removed). The code is preserved through child phase -> orchestrator -> terminal result: the phase child prints CAUSE_CODE=<code> on its own stderr line, the parent parses it without guessing (fail closed as a harness error if absent or invalid), and inconclusive_result reads it directly off the exception.
verdict_precedence.harness_integrity_failures: Harness/integrity failures are INCONCLUSIVE with their precise cause code (INSTALLED_REF_MUTATION, RECEIPT_MUTATION, PROJECTION_NONDETERMINISM, LINEAGE_BINDING_FAILURE, REOPEN_NOT_OBSERVED, CHECKPOINT_NOT_ESTABLISHED).
verdict_precedence.pass_requires: PASS requires every scientific and integrity invariant to hold.
verdict_precedence.scientific_fail_only_when: The experiment is otherwise valid but lineage semantics fail, including: gen2 remains inherited after valid REOPEN(gen1); gen3 remains inherited; unrelated rootU becomes questioned; gen4 probe is ADMITTED.

verified_memory_provenance.rule: The local scientific self-check verifies BOTH the pinned evidence.py bytes AND the installed-package provenance: the installed openline-verified-memory distribution must resolve, via its direct_url.json vcs_info.commit_id (PEP 610), to the exact pinned commit 36e3d0e0dab6a121abc1c14accbaa7310b5c2186. Fail closed on wrong commit, missing provenance, or byte mismatch. Bytes alone are not sufficient: the authorized primary runs locally, not only in CI. A contract test proves wrong-commit provenance fails the self-check.
